style_authority.note: Treats the sheet as a calm repeated-use operations surface and keeps motion only where it preserves causality, state, and direct manipulation.

reference_selection.note: Applies only the projected motion-quality, interaction-physics, motion-planning, product-context, accessibility, and validation guidance relevant to the gesture.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Questions each animated property, removes decorative whole-sheet scaling and broad transitions, and does not treat more animation as better.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review as static implementation evidence and makes no browser, frame-rate, computed-style, Reduced Motion, or device-performance claim.

verified_boundary.note: Separates inspected source behavior from unverified runtime jank, touch feel, layout cost, hidden code, responsive behavior, focus, and assistive-technology behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves covering pointer ownership, grab offset, transform tracking, presentation-value interruption, CSS px/s velocity handoff, bounded target semantics, soft boundaries, and Reduced Motion.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and motion-specific with five blocking findings, eight moves, and no unrelated feature or visual redesign work.
